crossRefs.note: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath…

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
translations.bsb: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
translations.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
translations.asv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
